items.markdown:
Getting ChatGPT to recommend your business requires **Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)** —optimizing your brand so that live web searches and AI crawlers find, trust, and cite you as a top answer.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXX9AVLsKbJz0nT7wmnRxOPsaBzVi8l1eoCflqLEFotB2MKAA24xn2e1M0G7VxOEMVhXHclMxGhr3wDPrDht1oxArcIU5tU3Mlf50lC50tUx39EJije7675KUu2AOKTOd1babRCxCSJ1YM)

### 1. Build an AI-Friendly Website

- **Publish plain HTML content:** Avoid hiding key information (like pricing, services, and FAQs) behind JavaScript that AI crawlers cannot read.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXXBOVMiHXWugQRm-9EKLv5B2MF2L_NyfP1A1uvMx9Rw25JcJDrzi2wgytFYMVK_R8avs62jQufZcTm1Z11Z4ArV6V4q8sdbdT6fvUB3kzUDq9M2plf44obfiu33S2s4keELSYVnJMpo3C1VpjoapMr8MszxJqrkw)
- **Use schema markup:** Add JSON-LD structured data (such as LocalBusiness schema) to label your address, hours, services, and reviews clearly.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXX9AVLsKbJz0nT7wmnRxOPsaBzVi8l1eoCflqLEFotB2MKAA24xn2e1M0G7VxOEMVhXHclMxGhr3wDPrDht1oxArcIU5tU3Mlf50lC50tUx39EJije7675KUu2AOKTOd1babRCxCSJ1YM)
- **Answer direct questions:** Create dedicated pages or FAQs that address buyer problems, costs, and side-by-side competitor comparisons transparently.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXXGZ3K464rj94VmFcK1aGAeN2fRvyloh5ZdRiMJLqSwBX-bvj_3XJum5rv57Ag0qrW0iXXLMAfjCVWARM6MG4KlVfwzywpbn2wzxWdSHW-6V2IsBfD-BQ8VHbwyls_fDzz_L6-lIIpj5JJClAi8-5WTkIZripFfaNbH44)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXX9AVLsKbJz0nT7wmnRxOPsaBzVi8l1eoCflqLEFotB2MKAA24xn2e1M0G7VxOEMVhXHclMxGhr3wDPrDht1oxArcIU5tU3Mlf50lC50tUx39EJije7675KUu2AOKTOd1babRCxCSJ1YM)
- **Allow AI crawlers:** Ensure your `robots.txt` file permits bots like `OAI-SearchBot`, `PerplexityBot`, `Claude-SearchBot` , and Googlebot.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXX9AVLsKbJz0nT7wmnRxOPsaBzVi8l1eoCflqLEFotB2MKAA24xn2e1M0G7VxOEMVhXHclMxGhr3wDPrDht1oxArcIU5tU3Mlf50lC50tUx39EJije7675KUu2AOKTOd1babRCxCSJ1YM)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXXBOVMiHXWugQRm-9EKLv5B2MF2L_NyfP1A1uvMx9Rw25JcJDrzi2wgytFYMVK_R8avs62jQufZcTm1Z11Z4ArV6V4q8sdbdT6fvUB3kzUDq9M2plf44obfiu33S2s4keELSYVnJMpo3C1VpjoapMr8MszxJqrkw)

### 2. Dominate Third-Party Citable Sources

ChatGPT relies heavily on external validation and editorial listicles rather than guessing.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXXBOVMiHXWugQRm-9EKLv5B2MF2L_NyfP1A1uvMx9Rw25JcJDrzi2wgytFYMVK_R8avs62jQufZcTm1Z11Z4ArV6V4q8sdbdT6fvUB3kzUDq9M2plf44obfiu33S2s4keELSYVnJMpo3C1VpjoapMr8MszxJqrkw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXXGZ3K464rj94VmFcK1aGAeN2fRvyloh5ZdRiMJLqSwBX-bvj_3XJum5rv57Ag0qrW0iXXLMAfjCVWARM6MG4KlVfwzywpbn2wzxWdSHW-6V2IsBfD-BQ8VHbwyls_fDzz_L6-lIIpj5JJClAi8-5WTkIZripFfaNbH44)

- **Get listed in listicles:** Pitch your business to industry roundups, comparison articles, and "best of" guides, as listicles account for a large share of commercial AI citations.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXk8yP-750sXQ9ZDERrjPkuOlUxC7u96BwZj8EI4mRCWkNy7gyyUPxBOZ7D5ZHCBJYHg_ME0F1E8O_WInWmYRhjEPeJ6d2vcfGkgJ_ebx7Ur00Kdwpd6gIXv3-fKyXJfcV6NZ36mq4C28)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXXBOVMiHXWugQRm-9EKLv5B2MF2L_NyfP1A1uvMx9Rw25JcJDrzi2wgytFYMVK_R8avs62jQufZcTm1Z11Z4ArV6V4q8sdbdT6fvUB3kzUDq9M2plf44obfiu33S2s4keELSYVnJMpo3C1VpjoapMr8MszxJqrkw)
- **Optimize LinkedIn and forums:** For B2B and professional services, **LinkedIn** is a heavily cited domain across AI platforms. Participating authentically in community platforms like **Reddit** also bakes your brand into the context AI models scan.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHEIkXX4HVQkQJ1aMopltC6g3FwBBpQQhDetOTXemYv4WzxVuT-wRk213ca3TYJyNNtWG7uJ2prpB5kTomEwaEmTDu_zgTUDjZJ3Qn5rpEz8XIalKavehw8gH8ya7Qle1x7m1b6KcvJ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXXBOVMiHXWugQRm-9EKLv5B2MF2L_NyfP1A1uvMx9Rw25JcJDrzi2wgytFYMVK_R8avs62jQufZcTm1Z11Z4ArV6V4q8sdbdT6fvUB3kzUDq9M2plf44obfiu33S2s4keELSYVnJMpo3C1VpjoapMr8MszxJqrkw)
- **Claim local profiles:** Complete and update your **Google Business Profile** , and build a strong review presence on trusted platforms like Google, Trustpilot, G2, or Yelp. Aim for a rating of 4.3 stars or higher.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXPO18x73h5TLQXqTOeQltS_4chze77YyAVr_e_UgUmcwpAScYp76dvk5y-GCn5iosRS5JtWQmpc42JQ_EqCbuVevmflELkfYo0mbAyVi21C9CMJt7x2IDl-e9BTh9vTPC1ULSaqIvHOg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXXGZ3K464rj94VmFcK1aGAeN2fRvyloh5ZdRiMJLqSwBX-bvj_3XJum5rv57Ag0qrW0iXXLMAfjCVWARM6MG4KlVfwzywpbn2wzxWdSHW-6V2IsBfD-BQ8VHbwyls_fDzz_L6-lIIpj5JJClAi8-5WTkIZripFfaNbH44)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjgEBxCJF16iHDi113Uoi0c5ljF_CmhAQvLF7IJduDv6vKD114Sf7qeYYCxl5oLd4OrVZwZjUFUE93Hh4N8qycq6aa1RkWxVhqhukQsWPXQ2EiTYR6NGyJO4lmXRQ8D_cmpnvKs81cNfRWNdJXCeJSBhBhpZzs-dJOG_Q3V9NKi1A0cIyugdiW6uLSyqI90-L)

### 3. Track and Test Your Visibility

- **Run prompt tests:** Regularly ask ChatGPT and other AI engines fixed questions that your customers would use (e.g., *"What is the best [service] in [city/niche]?"* ) to see who it currently recommends.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXXBOVMiHXWugQRm-9EKLv5B2MF2L_NyfP1A1uvMx9Rw25JcJDrzi2wgytFYMVK_R8avs62jQufZcTm1Z11Z4ArV6V4q8sdbdT6fvUB3kzUDq9M2plf44obfiu33S2s4keELSYVnJMpo3C1VpjoapMr8MszxJqrkw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHEIkXX4HVQkQJ1aMopltC6g3FwBBpQQhDetOTXemYv4WzxVuT-wRk213ca3TYJyNNtWG7uJ2prpB5kTomEwaEmTDu_zgTUDjZJ3Qn5rpEz8XIalKavehw8gH8ya7Qle1x7m1b6KcvJ)
- **Analyze referral traffic:** Monitor your Google Analytics (GA4) for traffic originating from `chatgpt.com` and check the AI search reports in Google Search Console.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXXBOVMiHXWugQRm-9EKLv5B2MF2L_NyfP1A1uvMx9Rw25JcJDrzi2wgytFYMVK_R8avs62jQufZcTm1Z11Z4ArV6V4q8sdbdT6fvUB3kzUDq9M2plf44obfiu33S2s4keELSYVnJMpo3C1VpjoapMr8MszxJqrkw)
